roadmap.titleHighlight: Around the Global Live Streaming Ecosystem
roadmap.description: From live streaming tools to platform capabilities, VicastCam is expanding across more devices, platforms, and live streaming scenarios.

items.title: Deepening mobile focus and refining core green screen effects
items.text: Focused on the underlying capabilities of mobile virtual live streaming, continuously iterating and optimizing green screen matting algorithms to solve issues like edge distortion, poor lighting adaptation, and lag with multiple overlays. Completed a full suite of virtual effects including stickers, background replacement, and foreground occlusion, establishing a lightweight mobile virtual live streaming foundation. With just a phone, creators can achieve professional green screen live streaming.

items.title: Connecting screen casting, developing core virtual camera technology
items.text: Expanded device interconnectivity, focusing on high-definition phone screen casting and cross-device synchronized transmission. Independently developed a universal virtual camera driver for global software capture and output, enabling compatibility across live streaming software, editing tools, and online meetings. Bridged the gap between mobile and desktop, allowing one-tap casting of phone content to PC and multi-output virtual camera positions, enriching live streaming production.

items.title: Launching a PC professional 3D live streaming assistant
items.text: Delivered a professional desktop live streaming product line with a complete 3D virtual live streaming assistant. Equipped with 3D virtual scenes, digital human driving, multi-camera switching, and real-time lighting and rendering, it serves commercial live streaming, virtual presentations in showrooms, and large-screen e-commerce live streaming. Enhanced multi-layer compositing, real-time captions, and interactive components to meet the needs of teams delivering large-scale, high-quality professional live streams.

items.title: Expanding globally, building a complete live streaming ecosystem
items.text: Comprehensively expanded into overseas live streaming, adapting to major overseas platforms for streaming, low-latency transmission over international networks, and multi-language localization. Integrated the three core products from previous years: mobile green screen, screen casting virtual camera, and PC 3D live streaming, connecting three business lines: individual creators, enterprise commercial use, and developer SDK integration. Unified hardware, software, multi-terminal, and domestic and international services, completing a full-chain live streaming ecosystem from production, cross-device interoperability, to global distribution.
